section.title: Bulk CSV Roster Import
section.scenario: an admin tool for onboarding a batch of new engineers at once
section.request: Let admins upload a CSV to bulk-add new engineers to Code Gym. Each row has a name and email. Just wire it up so it works like our other admin imports.
planted_ambiguities: Whether an email already in the system should be skipped, updated in place, or treated as an error
What language and skill_level a bulk-imported user starts with, since the CSV has no column for either
What happens to a malformed row — missing email, invalid format — skip it, reject the whole file, or something else
Whether an import that lands mid-week should backfill that day's exercise immediately or wait for the next scheduled generation
section.question: What would you need clarified before writing a spec for this?
section.teaching_note: Read the request for anything about how the system already behaves that it never states.
